one_line: P 15.1136 d, 1023 +- 33 ppm, 3.75 h, 86 events, SNR_emp 20.0; independently re-derived; pipeline v1.6 pixel on-target (dchi2 503 / 200 vs best alternative); red-team free-position deficit within 1.0 and 0.7 arcsec of the Gaia position; host KIC 6699878 flat at -1.8 +- 15.8 ppm; no ephemeris match; second localised signal at 47.69 d (post-hoc).
